qs.q: Complete the proverb: A small herd added to a small herd makes ____
qs.why: The proverb "A small herd added to a small herd makes camels" describes small amounts accumulating into a large amount.

qs.q: Complete the proverb: More indiscriminate than a wood-gatherer by ____
qs.why: The proverb is "More indiscriminate than a wood-gatherer by night"; someone gathering wood at night collects both what is needed and what is not.

qs.q: Complete the proverb: If your opponent becomes the ____, to whom can you appeal?
qs.why: The answer is "judge"; the proverb applies when the opponent is also the arbiter.

qs.q: Complete the proverb: Between ____ there is no reckoning
qs.why: The proverb says: "Between good people there is no reckoning."

qs.q: Complete the proverb: Whoever ____ will gossip about you
qs.why: The answer is "gossips to you"; the proverb warns against people who spread the faults of others.

qs.q: Complete the saying: Do not forbid conduct ____ the same
qs.why: The saying is: "Do not forbid conduct and practice the same."

qs.q: Complete the proverb: Your ____ has more room for your secret
qs.why: The proverb says: "Your chest has more room for your secret."

qs.q: Complete the proverb: He sells water in the quarter of the ____
qs.why: The proverb says: "He sells water in the quarter of the water carriers."

qs.q: Complete the proverb: What is in the pot is brought out by the ____
qs.why: The proverb says: "What is in the pot is brought out by the ladle."

qs.q: Complete the proverb: The beginning of ____ is a drop
qs.why: The proverb says: "The beginning of rain is a drop."
